text:
Sam (PM): Quick quarterly check — call out what shipped vs slipped across runtime v2, KV dedupe cache, and console rollout. Please reply with the OKR items you own + 1-line status (shipped/slipped/at risk) + next step. cc @Jia @Owen

Jia (Eng): runtime-v2 — shipped canary to eu-west/1; latency -8% overall but KV cache long-tail errors still popping. Status: at risk. Next: stabilize KV cache, hotfix PR #4821, need 1 approval. :eyes:

Owen (Infra): Dedicated autoscale infra changes slipped. Blocker: cloud quota not approved (CSP ticket #453). Status: slipped. Next: escalating quota today, will confirm ETA by EOD.

Priya (Eng-ML): quantization evals shipped baseline quant model to staging. Slipped on eval coverage (missed hallucination tests). Next: add eval sets + run nightly CI; assigning to @Priya to own.

Nate (Product): Console rollout — 50% rollout done. Telemetry gaps caused pause for full rollout. Status: partial ship / at risk. Next: add token-level telemetry + finalize feature-flag rollout plan.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed runtime-v2 to eu-west/1 at 1901234570

Sam (PM): Quick asks — who wants a canary window or rollback help from SRE? Also list any CRs you need reviews on. @Jia your PR needs 1 approval.

Jia (Eng): pinging @Owen and @Maya for network policy signoff on canary. PR pinned for 24h. :thumbsup: 

Owen (Infra): I can sign off after quota is confirmed. SRE, please add canary alert: ```alert: kv_cache_error_rate > 1% for 10m``` and a runbook.

Maya (Eng-SRE): Got it — adding alert + runbook. Runbook snippet:
```
if kv_cache_error_rate spikes:
  - scale pool +20%
  - disable aggressive prefix caching
  - if errors persist >15m, trigger rollback
```
I'll also add an on-call ping to the alert.

Sam (PM): Thanks all. Updated OKR tracker: https://redwood.company/okrs/q1-ship-sweep (link placeholder). Final ask: please update your OKR cards with 'shipped/slipped/next step' by EOD Fri. Any blockers you want me to escalate?

Priya (Eng-ML): Can you escalate eval infra for nightly runs? I need GPUs for 2x nightly jobs. :pray: 

Owen (Infra): Adding quota escalation to my ticket and CC'ing cloud infra team.

Nate (Product): I'll take telemetry follow-up and shepherd the rollout. Will post a short plan by tomorrow.

Sam (PM): Great. Thanks — will compile a short summary for execs on Mon. :rocket:
